tbpn_example.episode_title: Apple Goes Full Throttle on F1, Meme Stocks Make a Comeback, Amazon's New Wearable AI Device (Christina Cacioppo, Deena Shakir, Davide Asnaghi, Ylan Richard)

notes: Research: CARL = Context, Action, Result, Learning, a reflective-practice variant of STAR (health-professions and education reflection toolkits, competency interviews) that replaces Situation/Task with Context and adds a Learning slot. The registry adds a fifth slot, rule: the double-loop lesson after Argyris and Schon (Organizational Learning, 1978; Argyris, 'Double Loop Learning in Organizations', HBR 1977). Single loop corrects the action inside the governing variables (the thermostat turns the heat on); double loop questions the governing variable itself (why 68 degrees). Common misuse: Learning restated as the Result, or a single-loop 'be more careful' written as if it were a systemic rule. Classic example planned: a reflective-practice case from the domain CARL is taught in (a medication near-miss on a ward), where the single-loop learning is personal vigilance and the double-loop rule changes the storage policy. Decision: scout prompt is Part B verbatim plus the scratchpad line Part A requires and one sentence saying what a completed CARL event looks like in speech. Scout (step 3): three candidates returned: (1) Cala's shutdown post-mortem, 2025-07-23; (2) Perplexity's shopping/commerce misfire, Aravind Srinivas, 2025-04-23; (3) Mike Krieger on what Artifact taught him, 2025-09-29. Chose (1): a completed eight-year episode narrated by the founder two months after the shutdown, with the rare property CARL needs most, namely that every operating measure he gives succeeded (five very profitable restaurants, 60% retention, 95% satisfaction, the only proven payback on a robotic install) while the company still died, so the correction has to be made one loop up; he also names the governing assumption that failed ('we did not understand that when we created the business and structured the business') and then states four forward rules for the company he is incorporating, which gives the graph fact nodes in Learning and in Systemic rule and lets the derived nodes be the loop diagnosis and the market reading rather than the whole right-hand side. (2) was a close second and is the tightest chain in the corpus (stated governing assumption, shipped action, stated failure mode, explicit 'what we learned the hard way', explicit 'so that's my lesson from this'), but its double loop is a product-strategy correction rather than a change to a governing structure; kept as the fallback if a reviewer rejects (1). Correction to the scout: it attributed the Cala segment to Davide Asnaghi. L5844 introduces the guest as 'Elan' and the extraction's people list credits the Cala shutdown story to 'Elan (Ylan)', i.e. Ylan Richard, the last guest in the episode title; Davide Asnaghi is the Diodes/PCB guest in the same episode. All source_refs say Ylan Richard. Entity spelling: companies use the extraction spellings ('Cala', 'Sweetgreen'); the speaker is not listed in entities because the extraction spells him 'Elan (Ylan)', a transcription artefact rather than a name a future merge should key on. Idea-bearing slot: rule, the double-loop slot, where both derived nodes carry an idea (u5 formation-stack tooling that prices wind-down liability at incorporation, u6 the European Series A/B cliff as an underserved capital market). Graph (step 4): validate.mjs PASS, 0 errors, 0 warnings on the first run. classic 16 nodes (12 fact / 4 derived), 20 edges (3 fact / 17 derived); tbpn 27 nodes (21 fact / 6 derived), 34 edges (7 fact / 27 derived). Provenance rule applied to edges: fact only where one contiguous span states the connection ('but in the end, managed to have', 'And so the thinking from there was', 'got hung on', 'prevented us from doing that', 'And so ultimately', 'and we should have understood'); every generalizes_to edge from Learning to Systemic rule is derived, because the double-loop generalisation is precisely the inference the framework exists to make explicit. Design decision: the classic example is a nursing reflective-practice near miss, the genre CARL is actually taught in, and it mirrors the TBPN case structurally (a single-loop resolution about personal care superseded by a change to where the drugs are stored). Relations: kept the registry's four (motivates, produces, teaches, generalizes_to) and added constrains, needed for the two cases where a stated context condition blocks an action (French regulation preventing the restructure, the funding cliff hitting the scaling decision).
